## What is SAP Integration Suite?

SAP Integration Suite, part of the SAP Business AI Platform, is a modern, secure integration platform as a service (iPaaS) and enterprise integration platform that connects AI agents, applications, data, and processes across SAP and third-party environments.

[![placeholder](data:image/png;base64,)](//www.sap.com/assetdetail/2025/10/08ec69b9-2c7f-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html)

### SAP Integration Suite empowers businesses with:

* AI-ready, event-driven integration at scale.
* Thousands of prebuilt integrations and accelerators.
* AI-assisted discovery and development tools.

[Take a product tour](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/product-tour.html)

[Read the solution brief](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/what-is-sap-integration-suite.html)

### Integrate AI agents, apps, and data with one solution

Simplify fragmented landscapes by unifying SAP and third-party integrations, APIs, events, AI agents, and partner connectivity on a single platform built for AI-supported scenarios.

### Govern and run all processes with confidence

Operate mission-critical integrations reliably with centralized governance, real-time monitoring, and built-in security that keeps automation and AI safe at scale.

### Accelerate productivity with AI and prebuilt content

Move faster with thousands of prebuilt integrations and AI-assisted tools that reduce manual effort, improve reuse, and help teams deliver more with limited resources.

## Scale AI with confidence and control

Enable AI agents to securely access data, connect systems, and act across business processes using APIs, events, and integration services.

## Governed MCP tools

Safely expose enterprise APIs as governed MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers so AI agents can discover and use them without bypassing enterprise security.

## Bi-directional agent connectivity

Connect Joule and external agents (Microsoft Copilot, Claude, LangChain, and custom) through one governed surface.

## LLM and API governance

Apply consistent authentication, rate limiting, and policy controls to AI agent API traffic and large language model (LLM) usage from the same platform.

## End-to-end interaction audit trail

Log every agent, model, tool, and API interaction with end-to-end traceability so you can confidently operate AI at scale.

[Explore Enterprise AI Gateway](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/enterprise-ai-gateway.html)

## Faster time-to-value

Launch integrations quickly with thousands of prebuilt integrations, APIs, and events.

## Ready-to-use connectors

Connect SAP and third-party systems (Salesforce, Workday, AWS, ServiceNow, and many more) without custom code.

## AI-assisted integration design

Accelerate design with AI-generated integration flows that turn natural-language prompts into ready-to-edit integrations.

## Flexibility for any landscape

Integrate across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments using open data formats to fit architecture needs.

[Explore prebuilt integrations](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/application-integration.html)

## Stronger API security

Protect APIs with enterprise-grade security policies and AI-enabled anomaly detection.

## Cleaner core integration

Harmonize APIs and extend data models with Graph to simplify extensions for easier upgrades.

## Actionable API insights

Track usage and performance and unlock monetization with built-in analytics and dashboards.

## Faster developer onboarding

Accelerate adoption with a unified Developer Portal, branded experiences, and self-service onboarding tools.

[Explore API security capabilities](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/api-management.html)

## Event-driven connectivity

Enable asynchronous, real-time event distribution across SAP and third-party applications supporting resilient integration of end-to-end business processes.

## Real-time responsiveness

Keep systems and teams instantly updated on business changes and trigger immediate actions with event-driven processes.

## High scalability and flexibility

Scale event streaming across hybrid landscapes and manage the full event lifecycle with loose coupling for agility.

## Centralized control and visibility

Monitor, govern, and visualize event flows with advanced filtering, tracing, and distribution across any environment.

[Explore event-driven architecture](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/event-driven-architecture.html)

## Streamlined partner connectivity

Simplify complex B2B setups with AI-driven mapping and reusable templates.

## Simplified partner management

Manage partner contacts, identifiers, and settings in one place for easier onboarding.

## Secure, compliant interactions

Ensure secure data exchange and compliance with industry standards and regulations.

## Centralized visibility and control

Monitor and manage B2B scenarios across diverse environments from a single interface.

[Explore B2B integration](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/b2b-integration.html)

## Proven integration framework

Guide integration planning with structured assessments and lifecycle management tools.

## Built-in recommendations and tools

Jump-start projects using SAP reference architectures, best practices, and development guidelines.

## Structured collaboration

Capture and document integration requirements to keep teams aligned and projects on track.

## Holistic, agile approach

Align integration strategy with business goals to boost agility and operational efficiency.

[Explore integration strategy](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/integration-strategy-and-governance.html)

## Frequently asked questions

:   SAP Integration Suite supports [application integration](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/application-integration.html), API management, event-driven integration, B2B and EDI, hybrid connectivity, and agentic scenarios, all managed from a single cloud-based platform without the need for separate middleware per use case.

:   Yes. SAP Integration Suite is designed to integrate both SAP and third-party applications using prebuilt integrations, adapters, APIs, and event-based connectivity. The built-in [API management](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/api-management.html) layer lets teams publish, govern, and monitor every connection from one place.

:   SAP Integration Suite is delivered as a [cloud service](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/pricing.html) and supports [hybrid integration scenarios](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/application-integration.html), including connectivity to on‑premises and private cloud systems.

:   SAP Integration Suite provides the connectivity layer that [agentic AI](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/enterprise-ai-gateway.html) needs to act across enterprise systems, including secure APIs, real-time events, and governed data access. AI-assisted development tools let teams build integration flows from natural-language prompts, reducing the time to connect new systems or AI agents.

:   Yes. SAP Integration Suite supports B2B and EDI integration end to end, covering trading partner onboarding, message mapping, format validation, and real-time monitoring. Teams managing high volumes of partner transactions can use the dedicated [B2B integration capabilities](//www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/b2b-integration.html) without standing up separate middleware.

:   SAP Integration Suite includes centralized governance, real-time monitoring, and role-based access controls that apply across integrations, APIs, events, and partner connections. Teams responsible for [integration strategy and governance](https://www.sap.com/products/technology-platform/integration-suite/integration-strategy-and-governance.html) can enforce consistent policies while giving individual teams the access they need to build and operate their own flows.
